name: Pipeliners - Early Check 2026-10-05
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-10-05

# Summary
A small data file (`data.txt`) used for an early read on Oct 5, 2026 of pages edited in late September and early October. Each line lists a URL, clicks, impressions and average position for three GSC windows, and the last crawl or change status.

# Key findings
- 28 pages covered: blog posts from the AI-answer and not-indexed batches and the city pages edited Sep 25 to Oct 5.
- Status notes record whether Google had crawled the page after the change (for example "/sun-city/ Oct 5 (after)", "/reline-vs-replace.../ Sep 28 (BEFORE change)", "/maricopa/ Sep 25 (before); indexing requested Oct 5").
- Three posts were NOT INDEXED at the time: /5-signs-you-need-to-repipe-your-home-in-arizona/, /14-warning-signs-your-sewer-pipes-may-be-leaking/, /signs-of-outdated-sewer-drain-pipes/.
- Clicks were 0 for every page except one /scottsdale/ click.

# Decisions and status
- Too early to judge most changes; full reads were scheduled later (see the SEO Results Scorecard).
